title: A Veil for the Crown Again
author: Noor Nakamura
blurb: Odile Sandoval, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
